topics.name: Reauthentication Evidence Lifetime
topics.purpose: Define bounded reuse of fresh assurance evidence by exact resource/operation profile without converting one successful challenge into permanent elevation.

semantics.evidence_rule: Successful reauth produces explicit evidence linked to auth attempt/session/challenge.
semantics.scope_rule: Reuse scope is explicit: resource, operation/right, assurance level and session/identity.
semantics.rotation_rule: Where configured, successful reauth may rotate session/auth keys through explicit IAM lifecycle semantics.
semantics.expiry_rule: Expired evidence cannot satisfy new requests.
semantics.nonexpansion_rule: Evidence for one scope cannot broaden to unrelated sensitive resources.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
